annotations.title: Directory of courts and public offices

description:
Public addresses and contacts in France: courts, court registries
(greffes), town halls, CCAS, prefectures, public services.

Example: search_directory(query="tribunal judiciaire Dunkerque")

Args:
    query: name, town or type of office (French); OR/AND/NOT in UPPERCASE between
        two words are operators ("Lille OR Douai"); lowercase words are plain words
    category: directory category (optional)
    source: directory source (optional)
    limit: number of results (max 200)
